profile.headline: Junior Software Engineer at Davidson Technologies

positions.locationName: Los Alamos, New Mexico, United States

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description: Currently working as the graduate assistant for Project PREFER (NSF-funded project OIA-2019511). This semester involved information gathering and preliminary research into machine learning applications for prediction of weather phenomenon.

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
o	Performed experiments as part of a Department of Interior contract
o	Employed new data mining algorithms on open-source data sets
o	Refactored code banks and designed algorithms for optimization

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Project - Member QR Notifications 
o	Developed a full-stack web service to generate and push QR-based notifications
o	Worked alongside a team to develop and implement internal REST APIs
o	Configured backend engine to incorporate QR codes into pre-existing systems
o	Languages used: Python, Java, HTML/CSS, JS (incl. React), MySQL

Participated as part of an Agile engineering team in sprints, standups, and retrospectives
Worked with Sam’s Club Experience Teams (Product-Side, UX, Ops) through US and India teams

positions.title: Book Seller
positions.description: Most of my work here involved processing transactions and mobile orders for customers, as well as checking inventory and stocking shelves. In addition, I dealt with maintaining several store computers, updating software and diagnosing performance issues. At one point I was in charge of running an advertisement campaign for the store and providing daily analytics to my manager.
